comments.author: Me
comments.body:
For those of you who think "This is just another Casting recipe book that anyone can get, why should it be so expensive?" here's why: A) There's a 3 pre-discovery quest chain involved before you can even pull the Tatara furnace map that gets you this book, 1- "Adventurers Bible" quest(Search r1 and Dutch requreiments) from any of the 6 Starter Cities that gets the discovery "The Travels of Marco Polo", 2- "There lies the emperor's mountain" quest(Recognition r9 , Geography r11 and Quechuan required) from Seville that goes to Northeast Lima for the discovery "Potosi Silver Mine", and 3- "Ore deposit to the east" quest(Recognition r7, Geography r9 and Japanese required) from Seville that goes to the Eastern East Asia landing point for the discovery "Iwami Ginzan Mine", so, quite a few hours of sailing and skill ranking is required just to be able to get to the point where you can even attempt to get the map. B) It requires r14 Search and Unlock to pull and do this map, and it's recommended you have r14 Appraisal when trying to pull it as well. For anyone that does Adventure stuff, you know how hard it is to hit Unlock r14, let alone with r14 Search and Appraisal at the same time. As well, this map is very hard to pull, even if you meet all the requirements, I used 32 Headache Meds to get 2 copies of the map, 26 just to get my first one. All too often I see non-adventure types, particularly battle types, who want to pay some almost broke Adventurer minimum ducats for an item that took several hours of time and quite a few ducats both getting the item and ranking the skills needed to get it. Remember folks, without Adventurers, there would be no Excaliburs, Gae Bulgs, or Making Practical Japanese Armour 2 books. Please try to keep that in mind next time you want to underpay an Adventurer for their time and effort for an item you want to buy from one of them.

IGN: CullumStraun
